name: First-Line Support Triage
steps: Open the Helpdesk ticket list filtered to open tickets.
Review the customer's message to classify the issue type: password/login problems, billing/charges/refunds, bug report, or other.
If password or login problem: post reply with reset instructions (acme.test/reset) and close ticket.
If billing, charges, or refunds: do not reply to the customer; add the 'finance' tag and send an email alert to the owner with the ticket ID.
If bug report: post reply asking for reproduction steps and browser info, add the 'engineering' tag, and leave the ticket open.
If anything else: add the 'triage' tag and leave open for the owner.

fields.name: issue_type
fields.description: Classification of the customer issue based on message content

billing_alert.subject: Billing issue alert: Ticket {subject_id}
billing_alert.body: Heads-up: Ticket {subject_id} involves billing, charges, or refunds and requires your attention.

notes: Password/login reply must include: go to acme.test/reset, enter email, follow the link.
Never reply to the customer on billing/charge/refund tickets.
Bug reports require asking for steps to reproduce and browser.
